clue.text: Before "Journey's End", an unalterable belief?

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before
the end of a journey is its destination

explanation.surface: A question about faith held before reaching the final stop of life's journey.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the definition is loose: the doctrine holds that everything is fixed in advance, so it is a belief in the unalterable.
explanation.definitionFit: The doctrine that every event is fixed beforehand by God is a creed nothing can change.

clue.text: Tingling feeling a housewife comprehends

definitions.meaning: the prickling of a limb as numbness wears off
a housewife is an old word for a sewing kit, and comprehends means contains

explanation.surface: A woman at home notices a prickling sensation.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'housewife' (pronounced 'hussif') is also an old word for a small sewing kit, which holds the sharp items a seamstress needs.
explanation.definitionFit: The prickle of a waking numb limb is the idiom, and a sewing kit holds those sharp tools.

clue.text: Involve cook with first ingredients of egg mayonnaise

indicators.note: the opening letter of each of the two foods named is taken

parts.note: to broil is to cook by grilling

explanation.surface: A recipe step: prepare a dish beginning with egg and mayonnaise.
explanation.definitionFit: To embroil someone is to drag them into a dispute, to entangle them.

clue.text: Note on cosmetic powder written up as great success

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sitting on another is placed above it

parts.note: E is a musical note

indicators.note: in a down entry, writing a word upwards turns its letters backwards

parts.note: talc is a cosmetic powder

explanation.surface: A review of a cosmetics launch: a note on face powder hailed as a triumph.
explanation.walkthrough: 'written up' reverses TALC to CLAT under the E.
explanation.definitionFit: Eclat is brilliant acclaim, a dazzling triumph.

clue.text: In US, drive too close behind and agitate learner, perhaps

definitions.text: In US, drive too close behind

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the letters given might be arranged some other way

parts.note: L is the learner plate on a British car

explanation.surface: An American motorist harassing a learner driver by sitting on their bumper.
explanation.definitionFit: Following another vehicle too closely is the American sense of the verb.

clue.text: Governor-General bathing in Egypt? Trivial complaint

indicators.note: something bathing in a river sits inside it

parts.note: the Nile is Egypt's river, hence the question mark
GG abbreviates Governor-General

explanation.surface: A colonial governor taking a dip in Egypt, with a petty grumble.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits that Egypt stands for its river.
explanation.definitionFit: A niggle is a minor gripe or worry.

clue.text: Like twisting forces, damaged rail? Not so

indicators.note: damaged letters are knocked out of shape, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An engineer wondering whether a rail has been bent by stress, then deciding not.
explanation.definitionFit: Torsion is twisting under strain, so the adjective describes such forces.

clue.text: At start of evening song has to be changed in view of the audience

indicators.note: letters that must be changed are put into a new order
the opening letter of the word evening is taken

explanation.surface: A singer told that the opening number of the evening must be swapped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has to be changed' rearranges AT, E and SONG.
explanation.definitionFit: Being visible on the boards of a theatre means being seen by those watching.

clue.text: Very little apparently happening when the tide is out

definitions.meaning: an amount too small to make any difference

definitions.text: apparently happening when the tide is out
definitions.meaning: read literally, the sea level falls at low water

explanation.surface: A tiny amount, as when the sea recedes at low water.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, the phrase describes the sea level falling at ebb tide.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means an amount too small to matter, and at ebb the sea seems to fall.

clue.text: Calling rich person worn out? Good

parts.note: a nob is a wealthy or upper-class person
all in means exhausted

explanation.surface: Asking whether a wealthy person is exhausted, then judging it fine.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the umpire calls an illegal delivery a no-ball; doing so is the hyphenated verb.
explanation.definitionFit: An umpire's act of declaring an illegal cricket delivery is this verbal noun.

clue.text: One getting up steep part of stairs

definitions.meaning: a person who gets out of bed, early or late
the vertical board between two treads

explanation.surface: Someone climbing the steep section of a staircase.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone getting out of bed, and the upright board between stair treads, share this name.

clue.text: Take up a party point

parts.note: a do is a party

explanation.surface: Advice to embrace one political party's main argument.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt a cause or idea is to embrace it.

clue.text: Lizard appears to annoy one insect

parts.note: to gall is to irritate
I is the Roman numeral one
a wasp is an insect

explanation.surface: A reptile that seems to bother a stinging bug.
explanation.definitionFit: A galliwasp is a Caribbean skink, a kind of reptile.

clue.text: Shop-girl reportedly liable to be affected by complaints

definitions.text: liable to be affected by complaints

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a girl called Kate working in a deli, shop plus name

explanation.surface: A sales assistant said to be prone to illness.
explanation.walkthrough: DELI + KATE, said together, sounds the same as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A delicate constitution is one easily laid low by illness.

clue.text: Worldwide Marxists nearly all appear to be over 15

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over the second
nearly all of a word drops its last letter

parts.note: to come is to appear or arrive
the answer to 15 across, a junior hospital doctor

explanation.surface: Global communists, almost all of them seemingly beyond a certain age.
explanation.walkthrough: '15' points to the answer at 15 across.
explanation.definitionFit: The Comintern was the Communist International, the world body of Soviet-led parties.

clue.text: American medical student, 17 and new

parts.note: 17 across means bury, which is also inter

explanation.surface: A trainee doctor in the US, newly taken on.
explanation.walkthrough: '17' points to 17 across, put in grave, which is to inter.
explanation.definitionFit: In the US a recent medical graduate working in a hospital under supervision has this title.

clue.text: Head and most of back visible in viewfinder

parts.note: poll is an old word for the head

indicators.note: most of a word loses its last letter

parts.note: the stern is the back of a ship

explanation.surface: A photographer framing someone's head and most of their back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'viewfinder' is read as one who finds out people's views.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who canvasses opinion literally finds out views.

clue.text: Points to doctor put in grave position

parts.note: E and N are compass points
MB is a medical degree, so a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor's grim instructions about laying someone to rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To entomb is to place a body in a tomb.

clue.text: Drum upset routine around pulpit

indicators.note: around places the first piece on either side of the second
in a down clue upset turns a word upside down, so backwards

parts.note: a rut is a dull routine
an ambo is a raised pulpit in early churches

explanation.surface: A drummer in church disturbed by a fixed order of service.
explanation.walkthrough: An ambo is the raised reading desk of early Christian churches; 'upset' reverses the routine word before it goes round.
explanation.definitionFit: A tambour is a small drum, or a circular frame like one.

clue.text: Drug bar for American breaking-up ceremony

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis
a latch is a bar fastening a door

explanation.surface: A drug substituted for a lock in some American ritual.
explanation.walkthrough: A potlatch, among Pacific Northwest peoples, was a feast where goods were given away or destroyed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Native American feast involved giving away or smashing property, so a destructive festival.

clue.text: Goals partly determining final points

indicators.note: only part of the word determining is used

explanation.surface: Targets that partly decide where things end.
explanation.definitionFit: Termini are ends of a line or route.

clue.text: Be careful with money certificate involving a million

indicators.note: involving means wrapping round

parts.note: scrip is a share certificate
M stands for a million

explanation.surface: A share certificate worth a million calls for thrift.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrimp is to economise sharply.

clue.text: Republic taking line about Sunday

indicators.note: the first piece takes the next one on at its end

parts.note: Dominica is a Caribbean republic

explanation.surface: A Caribbean state lining up behind a sabbath decree.
explanation.definitionFit: Dominical means relating to the Lord's day.

clue.text: Stuff carried in Greek ship past cape

indicators.note: the ship goes past the cape, following it

parts.note: the Argo was Jason's ship

explanation.surface: Goods carried on a Greek vessel sailing by a headland.
explanation.definitionFit: Cargo is freight a ship carries.

clue.text: Mate in service

definitions.meaning: a friend, via Cockney rhyming slang plate for mate

explanation.surface: A friend in domestic employment.
explanation.walkthrough: In Cockney rhyming slang 'china plate' means mate.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhyming slang turns a pal into this porcelain word, which also names a dinner set.

clue.text: Eastern European going West to escape with partner

indicators.note: in an across entry westward is right to left, so backwards

parts.note: a Pole is a European

explanation.surface: A man from Eastern Europe heading west to flee with a lover.
explanation.definitionFit: To elope is to run off secretly to marry.

clue.text: North American keeping time, I have found, without conscious effort

indicators.note: keeping means holding inside

parts.note: an Inuit is a native of Arctic North America
I've contracts I have

explanation.surface: An Arctic native keeping time has discovered something effortlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Intuitive knowledge comes by instinct, not reasoning.

clue.text: Way to convey what happened to old offenders

definitions.meaning: a system for carrying goods or people
convicts were once shipped to penal colonies overseas

explanation.surface: A means of carriage, and the fate of convicts long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: British convicts were once sent to penal colonies such as Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: A means of carrying goods or people, and the old punishment of shipping convicts to colonies.
